- **tournaments** – the two World Cups, dates, host country, champion & runner-up
- **teams** / **countries** / **confederations** – national teams linked to country and confederation (UEFA, CONMEBOL, CAF, AFC, CONCACAF)
- **venues** – stadiums used, city, capacity, linked to tournament
- **tournament_teams** – each team's participation per tournament: group, final rank, whether it reached the knockout stage

**Match-level data**
- **matches** – every match with stage (group/round of 16/quarter/semi/final/third-place), date, venue, home/away teams, score, extra time, penalties, winner, attendance
- **match_team_statistics** – per-team per-match stats: possession, shots, shots on target, corners, fouls, offsides, passes, expected goals (xG)
- **goals** – every goal scored: match, scoring team, scorer, assister, minute, goal type (open play/penalty/own goal/header/free kick), running score
- **disciplinary_events** – cards: match, team, player, minute, card type, reason

**Player/squad data**
- **players** – name, position, date of birth, national team
- **squad_members** – tournament squad lists: shirt number, squad position, linked to tournament_teams

**Pre-built convenience views**
- **v_match_results** – matches with team/venue names already joined in, ready for quick lookups
- **v_player_goal_totals** – goals, penalties, own goals, and first goal minute per player per tournament
- **v_seeded_team_performance** – team-level tournament summary: matches played, wins, draws after extra time, goals for/against, possession, shots, xG, attendance

**What you can analyze with this:** match results and scorelines, top scorers/assisters, team and player performance stats (xG, possession, shots), disciplinary records (cards), squad composition, and tournament outcomes — all comparable across the 2018 and 2022 World Cups. Note the data does not extend to any other World Cup years.
